## Safety Checklist

- [ ] Uses fictional examples by default, or clearly scopes any non-fictional source.
- [ ] Does not include personal data, sensitive data, secrets, credentials, or private files.
- [ ] Does not include covert profiling requests.
- [ ] Does not add diagnosis, scoring, protected/sensitive attribute inference, or unsupported high-stakes use.
- [ ] Does not create a static persona catalog or runtime persona inventory.
- [ ] Does not add an app, CLI, API, backend, database, telemetry, or dependency.
- [ ] Preserves contradictions, unknowns, boundaries, and explicit non-claims.
- [ ] Does not inflate source-note or academic-boundary claims.

## Manual Review

- Checklist used:
- Result: `Pass` / `Revise` / `Block`
